description: The file defines the implementation of the FatalErrorHandler class, which handles fatal errors in the Orleans Runtime. It provides mechanisms to log fatal exceptions, output error details, and terminate the process upon critical failures.

classes.name: FatalErrorHandler
classes.description: Handles fatal error scenarios within the Orleans Runtime, providing logging and process termination.

methods.name: IsUnexpected
methods.description: Determines if an exception is considered an unexpected fatal error, excluding ThreadAbortException.

methods.name: OnFatalException
methods.description: Handles a fatal exception event by logging, outputting error details, pausing briefly, and terminating the process.
